# MCP for AI clients

The **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** lets AI assistants (Cursor, Claude Desktop, custom agents) call the **lomi. merchant API** for you: create checkouts, list payments, debug webhooks, without writing every HTTP request by hand. Most teams use the hosted server at `https://mcp.lomi.africa` or local stdio with `npx @lomi./mcp`. Access is scoped to your organization, the same as your API key.

## Connect with OAuth

Recommended: add the hosted MCP URL with **no API key**. OAuth-capable clients open **Connect with lomi.** in the browser, you sign in on the dashboard, and the client stores a scoped token (`lomi_oat_*`).

Two entry points, one product:

- **You have a lomi. account (or want one):** use the one-click buttons below. The consent page signs in or signs up, then returns to approve access.
- **Agent with no account yet:** connect `https://mcp.lomi.africa/mcp/guest`, call `lomi_register_agent`, then `lomi_provision`. Once `api_keys` returns a test key, the same session gains the merchant tools. See [Sandbox agent bootstrap](#sandbox-agent-bootstrap-no-key).

<McpOauthConnect />

Revoke a connected app from **Developers → API keys → Connect MCP → Connected apps**.

## Getting started

1. Click **Add to Cursor**, <a href={GROK_BOT_URL}>**Add to Grok Bot**</a>, <a href={buildClaudeOauthInstallUrl()}>**Add to Claude**</a>, or <a href={buildVscodeOauthInstallUrl()}>**Add to VS Code**</a> above (or paste the URL-only JSON below). OpenCode and Codex stay under the CLI sections.
2. On first connect the client receives a `401`, fetches `https://mcp.lomi.africa/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp`, and opens **Connect with lomi.**
3. Sign in to the dashboard, choose your organization, and approve access (read-only by default).
4. The client can call MCP tools immediately.

More templates live in the repo: [`apps/mcp/examples/`](https://github.com/lomiafrica/lomi./tree/master/apps/mcp/examples) (`cursor-http-oauth.mcp.json`, `claude-desktop-http-oauth.mcp.json`, plus API-key variants).

You can also start from the [dashboard](https://dashboard.lomi.africa): **Settings → Integrations → MCP**, then **Developers → API keys → Connect MCP**.

## Authentication

### OAuth (recommended)

OAuth-capable MCP clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, OpenCode, Codex, and others) connect without pasting a secret key.

1. Discover the resource server at `GET https://mcp.lomi.africa/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp` (also returned in the `WWW-Authenticate` challenge when connecting without credentials).
2. Register (optional DCR) at `POST https://api.lomi.africa/oauth/register`.
3. Open `GET https://api.lomi.africa/oauth/authorize` (PKCE + `resource` parameter).
4. Sign in on `https://dashboard.lomi.africa/connect/agent-connect` and approve.
5. Exchange the code at `POST https://api.lomi.africa/oauth/token`.
6. Connect to MCP with `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` (`lomi_oat_*`).

The MCP server introspects the token and scopes every tool call to your organization.

### API key (`LOMI_SECRET_KEY`)

| Value | Header / env | Where to get it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Secret key (`LOMI_SECRET_KEY`)** | `x-lomi-api-key` (HTTP) or `LOMI_SECRET_KEY` (stdio) | [Dashboard](https://dashboard.lomi.africa) → **Developers → API keys**: any **secret** key (`lomi_sk_…`) or an MCP key (`lomi_mcp_…`) from **Connect MCP** |

Your **`LOMI_SECRET_KEY`** unlocks lomi.’s hosted MCP endpoint and scopes every tool call to your organization. Send it in `x-lomi-api-key` and leave `Authorization` empty.

## Hosted MCP (HTTP)

| | URL |
| --- | --- |
| MCP endpoint | `https://mcp.lomi.africa/mcp` |
| Guest bootstrap (no key) | `https://mcp.lomi.africa/mcp/guest` |
| Health (optional) | `https://mcp.lomi.africa/health` |
| Ready check (optional) | `https://mcp.lomi.africa/ready` |

URL-only config (OAuth):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "lomi.": {
      "url": "https://mcp.lomi.africa/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

API-key config (fallback):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "lomi.": {
      "url": "https://mcp.lomi.africa/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "x-lomi-api-key": "YOUR_LOMI_SECRET_KEY"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Replace `YOUR_LOMI_SECRET_KEY` with your real API key, then restart your MCP client.

## Sandbox agent bootstrap (no key)

If the client has no merchant key yet, connect `https://mcp.lomi.africa/mcp/guest` (no headers). Call **`lomi_register_agent`**: the server solves a short proof-of-work and this MCP session adopts a sandbox-only `lomi_prov_*` key.

Then `lomi_provision action=create_account`, `upload_document`, `complete`, and `api_keys`. As soon as a `lomi_sk_test_*` key comes back, the guest session upgrades in place: the merchant tools (`lomi_checkout`, `lomi_customers`, `lomi_webhooks`, ...) are registered on the live session and the server sends `notifications/tools/list_changed`, so the client refreshes its tool list without reconnecting. Everything runs in TEST mode.

Live money still requires `lomi_provision action=request_live` and human approval at [dashboard.lomi.africa/connect/go-live](https://dashboard.lomi.africa/connect/go-live). Live keys are only shown in the dashboard, never over MCP.

## Claude Code

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http lomi https://mcp.lomi.africa/mcp
```

On first use, Claude Code opens **Connect with lomi.** in the browser.

## OpenCode

```bash
opencode mcp add lomi --url https://mcp.lomi.africa/mcp
opencode mcp auth lomi
```

## Codex

```bash
codex mcp add lomi --url https://mcp.lomi.africa/mcp
codex mcp login lomi
```

## Agent Plugin (Cursor, Codex, Copilot)

Install the lomi. plugin from your client's marketplace when it is available ([lomiafrica/agent-plugin](https://github.com/lomiafrica/agent-plugin)). You can always connect directly with the hosted MCP URL shown above; you do not need the plugin.

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add lomiafrica/agent-plugin
codex plugin add lomi@lomi
```

## Connect with stdio (local)

Runs the MCP server on your machine, no transport token needed. Good for local development.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "lomi.": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@lomi./mcp"],
      "env": {
        "LOMI_SECRET_KEY": "YOUR_LOMI_SECRET_KEY",
        "LOMI_API_URL": "https://api.lomi.africa"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Or run directly:

```bash
npx -y @lomi./mcp
```

Set `LOMI_API_URL` to `https://sandbox.api.lomi.africa` when working against sandbox data.

## Sandbox vs live

| Mode | `LOMI_API_URL` (stdio) | API keys |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Live** | `https://api.lomi.africa` | Live secret keys from the dashboard |
| **Sandbox** | `https://sandbox.api.lomi.africa` | Sandbox secret keys from the dashboard |

For HTTP MCP, tool calls use whichever API environment your `LOMI_SECRET_KEY` belongs to.

## Tools, resources, and prompts

- Merchant tools are **resource tools** named `lomi_<resource>` with a required `action` (for example `lomi_customers` with `action=list`, `lomi_invoices` with `action=pdf`). Mechanical `lomi_post_*` / `lomi_get_*` aliases are not registered.
- **`lomi_search_tools`**: search the tool catalog when your client loads tools on demand.
- **`lomi_register_agent`**: mint a sandbox provisioning key (guest or any session).
- Provisioning: `lomi_provision` and `lomi_partners` (same `action` pattern).
- **Resources**: `lomi://docs/getting-started`, `lomi://docs/authentication`, `lomi://docs/idempotency`, `lomi://docs/pagination`, `lomi://docs/webhooks`, `lomi://docs/money`, `lomi://docs/recipes`, `lomi://docs/finance`, `lomi://docs/errors`, `lomi://tools/index`.
- **Prompts**: `provision_merchant_from_zero`, `onboard_merchant`, `debug_failed_payment`, `setup_webhook`, `setup_network_operator`, `month_end_close`.

## API ↔ MCP

Each MCP action below is the twin of one REST operation. Direct charges and `POST /usage/events` are not exposed over MCP.

<McpOperationIndex />

## Agent-driven onboarding (0 to 1)

Provisioning tools let an agent create a merchant account, upload KYC documents, complete onboarding, and retrieve **test** API keys before any merchant secret exists. MCP exposes this as **`lomi_provision`** with `action` (`create_account`, `upload_document`, `extract`, `complete`, `status`, `api_keys`, `request_live`, `live_status`).

**Human claim link.** `create_account` needs `email`, `full_name`, `terms_accepted_at`, and `terms_version`. Leave `password` out: the response includes a `claim_url` (`dashboard.lomi.africa/connect/claim?token=...`, valid 7 days, single use). Send this link to the human; they set their own password there and own the account. `status` reports `human_claimed` and re-issues `claim_url` until it flips to `true`. `request_live` returns `human_claimed` too: the human must claim before approving live mode.

| Value | Header / env | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Provisioning key (`LOMI_PROVISIONING_KEY`)** | `x-lomi-provisioning-key` | Bootstrap credential (`lomi_prov_*`) for `/provisioning/*` |
| **Merchant secret (`LOMI_SECRET_KEY`)** | `x-lomi-api-key` | After onboarding completes, use test keys from `GET /provisioning/merchants/{id}/api-keys` |

Hosted HTTP example for a brand-new merchant (provisioning only until you have `lomi_sk_test_*`):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "lomi.": {
      "url": "https://mcp.lomi.africa/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "x-lomi-provisioning-key": "YOUR_LOMI_PROVISIONING_KEY"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

After onboarding, add `x-lomi-api-key` (or switch env to `LOMI_SECRET_KEY`) for payment and catalog tools. **TEST** mode works immediately; **LIVE** requires KYC clearance (AI for starter accounts, admin review for registered businesses).

Self-service OAuth onboarding uses the same **Connect with lomi.** flow. The MCP server introspects the token and provisions a scoped `lomi_prov_*` for your session. Self-service accounts are capped (verified email required, test-only, low daily merchant limits).

### Partner API (platform integrators)

Authorized platforms receive a **`lomi_partner_*`** management key from lomi admin. They mint per-end-user **`lomi_prov_*`** keys via MCP **`lomi_partners`** (`action=mint_key`, `list_keys`, `revoke_key`, `usage`) or the REST routes:

| Endpoint | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /partners/provisioning-keys` | Mint a scoped provisioning key for an `external_user_ref` |
| `GET /partners/provisioning-keys` | List keys |
| `DELETE /partners/provisioning-keys/{id}` | Revoke a key |
| `GET /partners/usage` | Usage summary |

Send `x-lomi-partner-key: lomi_partner_*` (or `Authorization: Bearer lomi_partner_*`). End users pass the returned `lomi_prov_*` to MCP or `/provisioning/*`. Monitor partners and audit events in **admin.lomi.africa → Provisioning**.

## Deploying your own MCP server

Most integrators use `https://mcp.lomi.africa` or local stdio. Deploying a separate MCP instance is for **lomi. engineering and operators** only. See [Maintaining CLI and MCP](/resources/contributing/maintaining-cli-mcp).
